queries_run: Intuitive Surgical tariff section 232 medical devices 2026

findings.claim: 多數器械與配件在墨西哥 Mexicali 製造，多數符合 USMCA 原產地而至今未被課美國進口關稅；內視鏡多在德國製造且受關稅；自中國進口原料與組件、並將美製 da Vinci Xi 賣入中國，皆受關稅，預期持續不利中國 Xi 系統產品成本。2025 年關稅與其他貿易措施使銷貨成本增加約 6,300 萬美元，預期 2026 年續增。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 7 MD&A（Trade and Tariffs Update）
findings.excerpt: We currently manufacture a significant majority of our instruments and accessories in Mexicali, Mexico. Most of these products qualify as originating under the USMCA and, therefore, have not been subject to U.S. import tariffs to date. We also import certain raw materials and finished goods from outside of the U.S. that are subject to tariffs, including our endoscopes, a majority of which are manufactured in Germany.

findings.claim: 2025 年關稅與其他貿易措施使銷貨成本增加約 6,300 萬美元，並預期 2026 年關稅帶來的銷貨成本續增。
findings.excerpt: In 2025, tariffs and other trade measures have increased our cost of revenues by approximately $63.0 million. Based on the announced and implemented global tariffs as of the date of this report, and assuming such tariffs remain in place, we expect our cost of revenues driven by tariffs and other trade measures to continue to increase in 2026.

findings.claim: 2025 年中國政府宣布對含中國產稀土的部分產品實施出口管制與許可要求；稀土為公司產品部分零組件的關鍵材料，若實施可能需為部分產品申請出口許可，並可能造成供應中斷。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: For example, in 2025, the Chinese government announced export controls and licensing requirements applicable to certain products containing Chinese-origin rare earth elements and may implement additional controls in the future. Rare earth elements are critical to certain components contained in our products, and China is a predominant producer of these materials.

findings.claim: 搜尋摘要顯示美國商務部自 2025-09-02 起對醫療器材啟動 Section 232 調查；搜尋未見已對器械全面課徵 232 關稅的來源。
findings.source: AmCham Malaysia：US Opens Tariff Probes into Medical Equipment, Robotics, Industrial Machinery

findings.claim: Q2 2026 10-Q 提及臨時 Section 122 附加稅到期後，美國依 Section 301 對 60 個貿易夥伴加徵一般 10% 或 12.5% 關稅。
